app.name: Filee
home.title: Home
home.drop_hint: Or hold {0} while dragging files in Explorer. The donut toolbar opens at your cursor.
home.recent_empty: Your converted files will show up here.
error.no_route: No engine can do this conversion
engine.reason.needs_package: Needs {0}. Install it in Settings → Engines
engine.magick.description: Images: JPG, PNG, WEBP, AVIF, HEIC, TIFF, GIF, BMP, ICO, PSD, TGA, JPEG XL, camera RAW and more, re-encoded with your preset's quality, size and DPI.
engine.pdfium.description: Renders PDF pages to PNG, JPG and TIFF (also multi-page TIFF and GIF) at the preset's resolution.
engine.pdfsharp.description: Makes PDFs from images and merges, splits or cuts page ranges out of PDFs.
engine.rhwp.description: Renders HWP/HWPX to PDF and converts HWP ↔ HWPX. It also draws every PDF made through the HWPX writer (DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, Markdown, e-books…).
engine.unhwp.description: Extracts text, Markdown and HTML from HWP and HWPX.
engine.spreadsheet.description: XLSX, XLS, ODS, CSV and TSV into each other (XLS is read only), with the numbers and dates the spreadsheet shows; one CSV per sheet.
engine.ooxml.description: Macro-enabled files and templates (DOCM, DOTX, XLSM, XLTX, PPTM, POTX, PPSX) ↔ DOCX, XLSX and PPTX; macros are removed.
engine.hwpx-writer.description: Reads Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF, HTML, e-books, Markdown and text and writes HWPX without Office or LibreOffice. It's the first step of every document conversion to PDF.
engine.docx-writer.description: Writes Word documents (DOCX) from PDF, HWP/HWPX, Markdown, HTML, text, spreadsheets, slides and e-books.
engine.pdf-text.description: Extracts the text of PDFs in reading order, also from two-column pages (no OCR for scans).
engine.email.description: E-mails (EML) to HTML and text with sender, recipients and date, pictures included; attachments into a ZIP.
engine.vector.description: SVG and SVGZ to vector PDF and to images; Illustrator files saved with PDF content.
engine.icns.description: macOS app icons (ICNS) from and to images.
engine.font.description: Fonts: TTF, OTF, WOFF, WOFF2 and EOT into each other.
engine.cad.description: AutoCAD drawings: DWG ↔ DXF, and both to PDF, SVG and PNG.
engine.archive.description: Extracts ZIP, 7Z, RAR, TAR, GZ, ISO and other archives, repacks them as ZIP, 7Z or TAR.GZ and compresses files into one archive (7-Zip).
engine.ebook.description: E-books: EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, FB2 and comics (CBZ, CBR) to PDF, EPUB, DOCX and text; documents and Markdown to EPUB; PDF to CBZ.
engine.ffmpeg.description: Video and audio: MP4, MOV, MKV, WEBM, AVI, MP3, M4A, WAV, FLAC and more; extracts the sound of videos and makes GIFs.
engine.pandoc.description: Markdown and HTML ↔ ODT and RTF, DOCX → Markdown, and reStructuredText and LaTeX ↔ Markdown, HTML, DOCX and ODT.
engine.ghostscript.description: EPS, PostScript and older Illustrator files to PDF and images; PDF to EPS and PS.
engine.calibre.description: Rare e-book formats (LIT, LRF, CHM, PDB, RB…) and Kindle output (MOBI, AZW3).
engine.libreoffice.description: Older and less common office formats (DOC, PPT, OpenDocument slides, Pages, Keynote, Numbers, WordPerfect, Works, Publisher, Visio, CorelDRAW…) and saving as DOC, XLS, PPT, ODT or ODP.
general.title: General
general.start_with_system: Start Filee when I sign in
general.context_menu: Show “Convert with Filee” in the Explorer context menu
general.context_menu_macos: Add “Convert with Filee” to Finder Quick Actions
general.context_menu_linux: Add “Convert with Filee” to the file manager
general.integration_macos: Finder shows the action under Quick Actions or Services. Enable it in System Settings > Keyboard > Keyboard Shortcuts > Services if it is hidden.
general.integration_linux: File actions are installed for Thunar, Nautilus, Nemo and Dolphin. Close Thunar before changing or pausing its shortcut, then reopen it to load the change.
general.modern_menu_hint: On Windows 11 this entry is under “Show more options”. Filee can also add it to the main menu; Windows asks for administrator permission once.
general.modern_menu_on: “Convert with Filee” is in the main Windows 11 menu.
general.modern_menu_outdated: The main-menu entry belongs to an older or moved copy of Filee. Add it again to update it.
general.modern_menu_cancelled: Cancelled. The entry stays under “Show more options”.
general.modern_menu_failed: Windows did not add the entry: {0}
general.modern_menu_remove_failed: Windows did not remove the entry: {0}
general.default_output_hint: Presets set to “Default save location” save here. A preset with its own location keeps it.
general.keep_dates: Keep the original file dates for every conversion
general.keep_dates_hint: Converted files get the created and modified dates of the original, with every preset. Off: only presets with "Keep the original file dates" do it.
general.no_history: Don't keep a history of recent conversions
update.notice_text: Press Update and Filee downloads and installs the new version. Your settings are kept.
update.notice_text_portable: This is the portable version. Download the new zip and unpack it over this folder. Your settings are kept.
update.installing: The installer is running. Filee starts again when it is done.
update.failed: Couldn't update automatically. Download the new version from filee.sh.
update.failed_alert: Couldn't download the update. Press OK to open filee.sh and download the new version there.
update.cancelled: Update cancelled. Press Update again to install it.
general.reset_confirm: Replace all presets and toolbar profiles with the defaults?
triggers.title: Shortcuts
triggers.description: Choose how the donut toolbar opens. You can add as many gestures as you like.
triggers.macos_permissions: Allow Filee in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Accessibility, then retry gestures. Finder also asks for Automation permission when you first use a selection shortcut.
triggers.linux_x11: Drag gestures use X11. The first enabled keyboard shortcut is assigned to the Thunar Filee action when file manager integration is on. Close Thunar before changing it, then reopen Thunar. Hold gestures and global selection shortcuts in other file managers are unavailable; use their Filee menu action or the drop zone.
triggers.linux_wayland: Cursor-following gestures are unavailable in this Wayland session. Use an X11 session for drag gestures, or convert through file manager actions and the drop zone. Thunar can use the first enabled keyboard shortcut after it restarts.
triggers.hook_stopped: Global input detection is stopped. File manager actions and the drop zone remain available.
triggers.excluded_hint: Process names separated by commas, e.g. photoshop, code
toolbar.title: Donut toolbar
toolbar.name: Name
toolbar.hint_add: Drag a chip onto the donut to add it
toolbar.hint_remove: Drag a slice back here to remove it
toolbar.hint_reorder: Drag slices onto each other to reorder
toolbar.hint_edit: Right-click a slice or use ✎ to edit
toolbar.max_reached: A donut holds up to {0} presets
toolbar.ext_none: No extensions yet. This profile is only used once you add some.
toolbar.ext_invalid: “{0}” isn't a file extension (e.g. jpg or tar.gz).
toolbar.ext_claimed_first: {0}: also in “{1}”, which comes first in the list, so these files still open “{1}”.
toolbar.ext_claimed_later: {0}: also in “{1}”. This profile comes first in the list, so these files now open this one instead.
toolbar.ext_unknown: {0}: Filee doesn't know this file type. You can keep it, but these files can't be converted.
toolbar.mixed_toggle: Use for mixed selections (files of different types)
toolbar.mixed_locked: Filee needs at least one profile for mixed selections, so this one stays.
toolbar.mixed_title: Show this toolbar when every selected file is one of:
toolbar.mixed_catch_all: Nothing checked: used for any mix of files that no other profile takes.
toolbar.mixed_shadowed: Nothing checked, but “{0}” comes first and already takes every other mix. Check some extensions to use this profile.
toolbar.mixed_covered: “{0}” comes first and allows every extension checked here, so this profile is never used.
toolbar.mixed_others_self: No mixed profile is left with nothing checked, so this one is also used for every other mix.
presets.title: Presets
presets.name: Name
presets.keep_color_profile_hint: Available when metadata is removed. Without the colour profile, wide-gamut photos (Display P3 from phones) can look washed out.
presets.multipage_tiff: Put every file into one multi-page TIFF
presets.multipage_tiff_hint: Each image, each PDF page and each page of a TIFF becomes a page, in order. One PDF is enough for a multi-page TIFF.
presets.merge: Merge all files into one PDF
presets.combine: Put all files into one archive
presets.extract_note: Each archive is extracted into a folder of its own. Where it goes is set under Output.
presets.keep_dates_hint: Converted files get the created and modified dates of the original, so photos still sort by date.
presets.delete_confirm: Delete “{0}”? It will also be removed from every toolbar.
presets.select: Select a preset to edit it
theme.title: Theme
theme.reduce_motion_hint: Recommended for older PCs. Turns off transitions and the donut's bounce.
engines.title: Conversion engines
engines.description: Filee picks the best available engine for each conversion. Engines higher in the list win when several can do the same job.
engines.optional_description: Large engines are only downloaded when you want them. They are kept when Filee updates and removed when you uninstall it.
engines.package.libreoffice.name: LibreOffice (older and rare formats)
engines.package.libreoffice.description: Only needed for older and less common formats: DOC and PPT, OpenDocument slides, WordPerfect, Works, Apple Pages, Numbers and Keynote, Publisher, CorelDRAW and Visio, and saving as DOC, XLS, PPT, ODT or ODP (includes the H2Orestart filter and Java). Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF, HWP and e-books convert without it.
engines.package.pandoc.name: Pandoc (Markdown, LaTeX, ODT)
engines.package.pandoc.description: Markdown and HTML ↔ ODT and RTF, DOCX → Markdown, and reStructuredText and LaTeX ↔ Markdown, HTML, DOCX and ODT. Markdown, HTML and text → PDF, DOCX and HWPX work without it.
engines.package.ghostscript.name: Ghostscript (EPS and PostScript)
engines.package.ghostscript.description: EPS, PS and older Illustrator files → PDF, PNG and other images, and PDF or SVG → EPS/PS. SVG and AI files saved with PDF compatibility convert without it.
engines.package.ffmpeg.name: FFmpeg (video and audio)
engines.package.ffmpeg.description: Video ↔ video (MP4, MOV, MKV, WEBM, AVI, WMV and more), video → animated GIF or a still image, sound from videos (→ MP3, M4A, WAV …), audio ↔ audio (MP3, M4A, FLAC, WAV, OGG, OPUS and more) and GIF → MP4, WEBM, MOV. Only needed for video and audio.
engines.package.calibre.name: Calibre (Kindle and rare e-book formats)
engines.package.calibre.description: Saves as MOBI and AZW3 for Kindle, and converts rare e-book formats: LIT, LRF, PDB, PML, RB, SNB and TCR, plus CHM and OEB input. EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, FB2 and comics (CBZ, CBR) are read without it.
engines.package.system_required: Use a copy installed on this computer.
engines.remove_confirm: Remove {0}? You can download it again later.
engines.update_recommended: Update recommended: this copy is {0}, Filee is tested with {1}. Most conversions still work.
engines.use_own_hint: Already have it? Pick its program and Filee uses that instead of downloading its own.
engines.use_own_missing: That folder doesn't have everything Filee needs: {0}.
engines.remove_failed: The engine is in use. Try again after the running conversions have finished.
about.title: About
about.license: Filee is free software under the MIT license.
about.support_text: Filee is free and open source. A star on GitHub, a bug report or a feature idea all help it get better and reach more people.
feedback.notice_text: A star on GitHub helps other people find Filee. Problems and ideas are welcome too.
setup.title: Choose conversion engines
setup.description: Filee already converts images, PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, HWP, e-books, archives, fonts and CAD drawings. Download engines only for video and audio or for rare formats.
setup.note: You can install or remove engines at any time in Settings → Engines.
watch.title: Watch folders
watch.description: Files that land in these folders are converted automatically while Filee runs. Downloads and copies are converted once they are complete.
watch.originals_keep: Leave the original where it is
watch.originals_hint: Moving originals makes the folder work like an inbox, and files already waiting there when Filee starts are converted too.
watch.cli_hint: Also on the command line: filee watch <folder> --to <format>
